bio: This is the place for anyone who appreciates fish crafted simply and with respect for tradition, allowing the freshness and quality of the ingredients, the true stars of each dish, to shout their name. In addition to the menu, ask the staff about the catch of the day. Fans of Italian cuisine will also find risottos and spaghetti among the lineup. Located just outside the city centre, the restaurant boasts welcoming dining rooms with a rustic slant that add to its warm, authentic vibe....
